Answer: E
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates a complete white-out of the right hemithorax. The mediastinal structures (trachea and heart) are shifted to the left, which is a contralateral shift indicating a space-occupying process like a large mass or effusion pushing from the right side. Among the choices, "large thoracic mass" fits this description of a space-occupying lesion causing contralateral shift.
